exposure: gestation sac evagination to the bladder
Gestation sac (GS) evagination to the bladder
outcome: Residual lesions after uterine artery chemotherapy and embolization (UACE) in combination with dilatation and curettage (D&C)
finding: Gestational age, human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) level, and the gestation sac (GS) evagination to the bladder were risk factors for residual lesions after UACE in combination with D&C for cesarean scar pregnancy.
